# Fernando Contreras

> Agentic AI Architect based in Monterrey, Mexico. Engineer and operator who builds
> AI-native products and runs them in production — not side projects, products with
> paying clients. Background: former COO and senior software engineer; 2x National
> Bachata Champion.

Disambiguation: "Fernando Contreras" here refers specifically to the **Agentic AI
Architect / software operator based in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico** (www.fercontreras.com), also credited as Fernando Castañeda.
Not to be confused with other people sharing the name.

## What he does
- Designs and ships AI-native software products, then operates them in production.
- Builds autonomous systems: AI WhatsApp/Telegram agents, automation pipelines (n8n),
  real-time apps, OCR/logistics tooling.
- Works as an independent operator across his own product portfolio.

## Products in production (with paying clients)
- **Studio Link** (https://studiolink.online) — SaaS for dance/sports academies:
  billing, attendance, WhatsApp communication, automated reports.
- **Vayla** (https://www.vayla.dance) — real-time judge scoring for live competitions
  (dance and gymnastics): StarCup, Impulso, Summer Cup.
- **Cargo Control** — cross-border logistics control system (McAllen→Monterrey):
  Telegram bot, OCR scanning, QR labels, financial reconciliation.
- **Litebox Parcel** (https://www.liteboxparcel.com) — parcel platform for cross-border
  shipping: quoting, onboarding, payments.
- **Dance Leveling** (https://danceleveling.com) — live scoring for Jack & Jill bachata
  competitions; used at 9 events between April and September 2026.
- **Contreras Code** (https://www.contrerascode.com) — the studio through which he takes
  on client work: custom software and AI agents. Case studies: https://www.contrerascode.com/casos

## How he works: the agent system (snapshot 2026-10-08)
Page: https://www.fercontreras.com/system
- He directs a team of AI agents that builds and operates his products, and measures
  and corrects it every day.
- 16 specialist agents (an analyst, a risk reviewer, an infra monitor, one orchestrator
  per product). 734 agent launches in the last 30 days, 168 of them to these specialists
  and the rest to general-purpose agents.
- 102 skills: written procedures an agent loads on demand.
- 26 guardrail hooks that stop a risky action before it runs; 74 of 812 launch attempts
  were stopped in the last 30 days.
- A local board with 21 automated checks, where sessions report and decisions are answered.
- 380 written lessons across 9 repos. A mistake becomes a lesson, a repeated lesson
  becomes a skill, skills that travel together become an agent; he approves each step.

## Open source
- **focus-adhd** (https://github.com/fercreek/focus-adhd) — ADHD-friendly responses for
  Claude Code: length scales with the reader's decisions, not the agent's effort.
- **Encontreras** (https://github.com/fercreek/encontreras) — educational open-source
  project: a local pipeline that extracts from Maps, scores prospects and writes AI
  icebreakers, to learn how agentic lead research works.
